description.value: M Smart eMobility is a dedicated e-bike shop in Tsawwassen serving the Delta/South Vancouver area. The store recently underwent a name change (previously operating under a different brand), with the ebikecanada.com website not yet updated to reflect the rebrand. Its eMobility focus suggests a specialization in electric bicycles, which could be valuable to touring cyclists seeking e-bike sales, service, or advice along BC's south coast routes.
